item.text: The notes cover grammar, lexical meanings, the child and partner denials, the scope of “everything,” divine measure, and several theological disputes. I’m grouping repeated answers while preserving the arguments and evidence each source adds.

The draft grouping accounts for nearly all notes. Two notes need explicit placement: Abū Ḥayyān’s definition of measure by place and time, and al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī’s decision to omit other interpretations. I’m adding them before writing the file.
